summary: Can-Fite BioPharma Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release regarding a peer-reviewed scientific publication on its drug candidates Piclidenoson and Namodenoson. The filing is a routine disclosure of scientific research and pipeline progress, not a material corporate transaction. No deal terms, board actions, or special-situation events are present. The filing merely reports an article in Biomolecules Journal summarizing A3 adenosine receptor agonist therapeutic potential. This is ordinary communication of business development, classification: None.
